item.title: Reliance Backed NexWafe in 7 GW Wafer Agreement For US Customer
item.description: Germany based solar wafer manufacturer NexWafe has entered into an agreement with Solar cell maker Talon PV for a wafer supply agreement in the US. NexWafe, which counts India's Reliance Industries and Saudi oil Major Aramco among its key investors, promises a leaner, more efficient process to make solar wafers that is competitive with options in the global market from China. item.title: KPI Green Energy Completes 92.4 MW Wind Project for Ayana Renewable in Bhuj with 28 WTGs
item.description: Gujarat-based KPI Green Energy has completed its 92.4 MW wind power project for Ayana Renewable Power Four at Nakhatrana, Bhuj, Gujarat. In a press release, KPI Green said the project comprises 28 wind turbine generators (WTGs). The KPI–Ayana project forms part of the broader renewable energy expansion by ONGC NTPC Green, which is actively commissioning both solar and wind capacity in Gujarat. item.title: Can the Rising BESS Market Dent the Prospects of Wind Projects in India?
item.description: With the sharp rise in Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) tenders and a visible strategic pivot by developers, India’s wind energy market appears to be entering a more competitive phase. As the government pushes to make renewable power more “firm” through the integration of storage, the share of BESS in India’s clean energy landscape is expanding rapidly. item.title: Green Stocks Feb 20- Vikram Solar Laid Low On Lock-In Expiry On Feb 23
item.description: On a volatile day when most significant upmoves on the green pack were news-based (KPI Green for commissioning a project, Pace Digitek for winning one), Vikram Solar slumped somewhat inexplicably by 10%. item.title: NTPC Arm Commissions 165 MW of 1.2 GW Khavda-II Solar Project in Gujarat
item.description: National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC) Limited declared the commercial operation date (COD) of 165 MW of solar capacity at the Khavda-II Solar PV Project in the western Indian state of Gujarat. In a regulatory filing, NTPC said the declaration relates to the second tranche of the 1,200 MW Khavda-II project. item.title: Sri Lanka Awards First 120 MW/480 MWh BESS Tender For 12 Projects
item.description: WindForce PLC has received Letters of Award to develop 12 standalone Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects secured through international competitive bidding. The 12 projects, with a combined installed capacity of 120 MW/480 MWh, will be developed as standalone BESS facilities under the Build, Own and Operate (BOO) model and will operate over a 15-year contract period.
